parsed.why: Entry-side pride-welcome programme eases passport-mismatch scrutiny; documented social acceptance and mature trans care. No hate-crime law, weak equality-act enforcement, custody/ward placement by birth sex. Strongest traveller-facing profile.

Morality offences (up to 5 years) used against gender nonconformity and transition; no recognition, no protections, no registrable advocacy. Militia killings of gender-nonconforming men 2014-15, torture 2012. Thin record resolves toward risk.

Federal passport/visa regime reaches every trans traveller: markers restricted, refusals, lifetime fraud exposure; bathroom bans criminally enforced in some states. Hate-crime and employment protections mitigate, but tier-1 universal exposure persists.

No criminalisation; no trans-specific border, facility or police exposure documented. Negatives are resident-facing LGR gap and hate-crime impunity, partly remedied by reopened prosecutions. Conservative society, thin recourse.

Criminalises same-sex conduct and public male deception as to sex, a presentation offence though unenforced; no recognition or protections, activist murdered 2021, rising hostility. Offset by embedded third-gender tradition.
